\section*{Biography}
I am a Ph.D. candidate at Beijing Institute of Technology (BIT), advised by Prof. \href{https://wu-yuwei-bit.github.io/}{Yuwei Wu} and Prof. \href{https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Sl6TV7gAAAAJ\&hl=zh-CN}{Yunde Jia}. I received my master's degree from Beijing Institute of Technology in 2023 under the supervision of Prof. \href{https://wu-yuwei-bit.github.io/}{Yuwei Wu} and Prof. \href{https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Sl6TV7gAAAAJ\&hl=zh-CN}{Yunde Jia}, and my bachelor's degree from Sichuan Normal University in 2018. My research interests include:

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Embodied Intelligence:} Memory and tool use for embodied question answering, reasoning, and decision-making.
\item \textbf{World Model:} Modeling dynamic environments to predict future observations and support long-horizon interaction.
\end{itemize}
